## File: google-deepmind_bsuite/bsuite/experiments/deep_sea/analysis.py

Prompts

```
['find the first episode where average bad episodes drops below a threshold for deep sea experiment data', 'compute a single score measuring how well an agent beats the dithering baseline on deep sea', 'plot learning time against an exponential baseline to visualize deep sea scaling performance', 'plot average regret over time by problem size for deep sea experiment results', 'plot individual run returns over time to compare performance across random seeds']
```

```
{'find_solution_deep_sea': 'find the first episode where average bad episodes drops below a threshold for deep sea experiment data', 'score_deep_sea_performance': 'compute a single score measuring how well an agent beats the dithering baseline on deep sea', 'plot_scaling_deep_sea': 'plot learning time against an exponential baseline to visualize deep sea scaling performance', 'plot_regret_deep_sea': 'plot average regret over time by problem size for deep sea experiment results', 'plot_seeds_deep_sea': 'plot individual run returns over time to compare performance across random seeds'}
```
